Minister Orders Drone Use Amid Elephant Threat to Tirupati Villages

Andhra Pradesh Minister Pawan Kalyan has directed officials to use drones to monitor wild elephants threatening villages near Tirupati. He also ordered night patrols and alerts for residents. The directive aims to address the growing concern over the elephants' proximity to human settlements. The use of drones is intended to provide real-time tracking and enable quicker responses to potential human-elephant conflict situations.
